description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt firmware upgrade process for specific platform configurations. It defines upgrade procedures based on board names and interacts with device environment variables.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that performs a check on the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade process based on the board name, setting environment variables and calling the default upgrade method.
